answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit ridge bond for a ridge rootstock, stamps a forge seal on one vine cutting, keys the graft to its key, and posts the seal on the vine board. Auditors recount the board: a graft survives only if seal, rootstock, and key match, one rootstock per graft; a mismatched graft burns the bond. The kth forge fee is 18+4(k-1), so the 1000th costs 4014 and 1000 clones pay 2,016,000 plus 70,000 locked, with no shared seal. A rented-graft ring fails: a rented seal key mismatches the claimant. An honest agent pays 88 once, bond returned after a clean epoch.
